summary: Georgia list places an adams lookout in Irwin County and the directory agrees on county; no source describes its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: List entry adams: Irwin County, coordinates, and a value of 353 in the elevation column
The list says its names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: Directory lists Adams in Irwin County

notes_for_editor: Two sources, both county-level. The list's elevation column has no unit; the record's 107.6 m assumes feet (353 ft), so the story gives the bare value 353. Two searches found no build, staffing, fire or fate history. The list's compiler says names for towers 73 and above are their own, so 'adams' may not be a historical name. The NHLR Georgia and FFLOS Georgia index pages in the crawl list no Adams entry. Other Adams pages in the directory cache are for towers in St. Lucie County, Florida and Robertson County, Tennessee; neither is this tower. The story is about 82 words, below the 120-word floor, because no further evidence was found.
